sources.snippet: 🔍 Overview This repository contains a complete implementation of a small-scale transformer language model featuring Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), inspired by modern architectures like Qwen3. The implementation includes training code with the innovative Muon optimizer, comprehensive data preprocessing, and an interactive inference system.
